thread:
zoe: quick sync — proposing a compact hosting_manifest that covers hosted/dedicated/private with an "env_overrides" map. fewer surfaces for SDKs.
mike: i like one manifest. main risks: private-specific fields accidentally used by hosted. we need field metadata (required_for/advisory_for).
anya: agree. add a small runtime probe so control-plane can validate at deploy: returns capability_version, supported_quants, max_seq_len.
zoe: probe example we discussed: ```json
{
  "capability_version": "1.1",
  "supports": ["fp16", "int8", "kv_namespaces"],
  "max_seq_len": 8192
}
```
mike: good. secret handling: manifest only contains secret_refs (type: managed|external, id: string). runtime resolves via local policy. no raw secrets.
anya: Dedicated needs scheduler hints: capacity_units, prewarm boolean. mark them required_for=["dedicated"] so lint can catch mistakes.
zoe: routing_policy should express evaluation order. e.g., routing_policy: ["prefer_low_latency", "prefer_cost", "fallback_variants"].
mike: add rollout_policy with canary_pct and success_eval_id. control-plane will run evals tied to that id for gating.
anya: cache_namespace hint too — private/dedicated may want tenant-scoped cache. field: cache.namespace and cache.scope=[global,tenant,model].
zoe: manifest.version: major.minor. policy: major bumps = runtime upgrade required; minor = additive. deprecation window = 8 weeks.
mike: devex: `redwood manifest lint` to call control-plane lint and show clear errors: missing required_for fields, unsupported quant, etc.
anya: ops: create e2e tests for the three modes covering model_pin changes, fallback routing, secret resolution, and canary rollback. make them PR gating.
deploy-bot: RFC created: https://redwood.internal/rfc/412-hosting-manifest-bridge (status: draft)
zoe: i'll draft the RFC with schema and probe spec. please review by EOD. :rocket:
